player_0.content: New plan: I entered the Guest room twice without tracking my visited locations, causing me to stop prematurely while unvisited rooms (like the one accessible from the Sauna via the Lobby) remained. Next time, I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms before making a move. If I encounter a room I have already been to, I will immediately choose a different untried direction instead of stopping. I will only issue "DONE" when I am certain all reachable rooms have been visited.
